top_stories.title: NIST and CISA finalize playbook to stop token theft and forgery
top_stories.summary: NIST and CISA have finalized NIST IR 8587, a guidance document to help federal agencies and cloud service providers protect identity and access tokens from forgery, theft, and misuse. The publication covers key management, token verification, token lifecycle controls, and the design and management of identity providers and authorization servers.

top_stories.title: Attackers Use Passkey Phishing to Hijack Microsoft Cloud Accounts and Exfiltrate Data
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has disclosed two threat actor campaigns targeting cloud environments, including one using passkey-themed social engineering to breach Microsoft cloud accounts and exfiltrate data. The attacks also involved sending over one million CEO-impersonation scam emails between August 3-5, 2026, leveraging third-party email delivery infrastructure for financial fraud.

top_stories.title: Postman Passport controls API access without exposing credentials
top_stories.summary: Postman has launched Passport by Postman, a standalone API security product now in general availability, designed to manage API access for both human and non-human identities. The product keeps API credentials within customers' environments while providing security teams with granular access control, full call attribution, and rapid credential revocation capabilities.

top_stories.title: Active Exploitation Attempts Target WSO2 API Manager JWT Bypass With Forged Admin Tokens
top_stories.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-5430, CVSS 9.8) in WSO2 API Manager is being actively exploited, allowing attackers to bypass JWT authentication through improper cryptographic signature verification. The flaw enables forged admin tokens and account takeover, with exploitation confirmed in the wild by watchTowr researchers.

top_stories.title: Malicious Twitch Browser Extension Leaks OAuth Tokens From Nearly 31,000 Users
top_stories.summary: A malicious browser extension called "Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot" exfiltrated OAuth tokens from approximately 31,000 Twitch users to proxy servers linked to a Russian commercial bot service. The extension was distributed across both the Google Chrome Web Store and Mozilla Firefox Add-Ons store, exploiting OAuth token access to compromise user authentication credentials.

news.title: The modern attack chain: Rethinking Google Workspace security in the age of AI
news.summary: The article analyzes attack patterns observed in the Vercel and Composio breaches, identifying a recurring attack chain targeting Google Workspace where email was not the initial entry point. The piece examines how these incidents share a common methodology, with implications for how organizations should approach workspace access security and identity threat defense.

news.title: KREMLIN Banking Malware Hijacks Chrome and Edge to Steal Credentials and Session Tokens
news.summary: Elastic Security Labs has documented a Brazilian banking malware called KREMLIN, tracked as REF9334, that hijacks Chrome and Edge browsers to steal credentials and session tokens. The malware uses browser extensions to impersonate Brazilian banks and has been active since at least May 2025.

news.title: Japan's Digital Agency says VPN flaw exposed 246,000 personnel records
news.summary: Japan's Digital Agency suffered a data breach exposing approximately 246,000 personnel records of government employees. The breach was caused by a VPN vulnerability that allowed unauthorized access to the agency's systems.

news.title: 3BB Attacker Used MeshCentral Backdoor for Root Access, Targeted Subscriber Credentials
news.summary: An attacker compromised 3BB, a major Thai broadband provider, using MeshCentral as a backdoor to maintain root access to internal machines. The attacker specifically targeted subscriber credentials, as uncovered by threat intelligence firm Hunt.io through an exposed attacker-controlled server.

news.title: IDrive Adds Microsoft Entra ID Backup to Strengthen Identity and Access Protection for Microsoft 365 Organizations
news.summary: IDrive has added Microsoft Entra ID Backup functionality to its IDrive Microsoft Office 365 Backup solution. The new capability is designed to help organizations protect and recover Microsoft Entra ID identity and access data.

news.title: Bastillion v5.2.1
news.summary: Bastillion v5.2.1 has been released, a browser-based SSH access management tool that functions as a bastion host with a dashboard interface. The tool centralizes SSH access control across multiple systems.

news.title: Okta Nearly Doubled This Year. So Why Is SailPoint Still Below Its IPO Price?
news.summary: The article compares the stock performance of Okta and SailPoint, noting that Okta's stock has nearly doubled while SailPoint remains below its IPO price despite delivering its fourth consecutive EPS beat in Q2 FY27. The piece is a financial analysis focused on the market valuation of two major IAM vendors.

news.title: Okta Targets AI Agent Confusion With Identity Security Push
news.summary: Okta is positioning its identity security platform as a solution for managing AI agent access, focusing on controlling where agents operate, which systems they can access, and what actions they are authorized to perform. The push reflects growing industry attention to non-human identity and access governance challenges introduced by AI agents.

news.title: Agentic Fabric and AI Could Drive SailPoint’s (SAIL) Next Growth Phase
news.summary: SailPoint reported its fiscal Q2 2027 results on September 9, showing 25% annual recurring revenue growth year-over-year. The company highlighted its Agentic Fabric and AI capabilities as key drivers for its next growth phase in enterprise identity security.

news.title: Univention Corporate Server: Who Does the Cloud Trust When You Log In?
news.summary: Approximately 5,000 Dropbox accounts were compromised through improperly verified Lenovo IDs, raising questions about federated identity trust in cloud environments. The incident centers on identity verification failures in cross-provider authentication chains rather than a conventional security vulnerability.

news.title: AI is changing what Salesforce security needs to govern
news.summary: WithSecure released a paper titled "Navigating Trust in the Modern Salesforce Ecosystem" examining how AI is changing security and governance requirements in Salesforce environments. The paper identifies that traditional governance practices covering identities, permissions, access, configurations, and controls are no longer sufficient as AI introduces new factors to manage.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents affecting European organizations. This regulatory change imposes new compliance obligations on organizations managing digital products, directly impacting IAM and security teams responsible for incident detection and reporting processes.

news.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
news.summary: A new attack technique called "workflow identity hijacking" has been identified, which can bypass standard security controls by exploiting unauthenticated entry points to compromise AI-driven workflows. The attack targets identity-based vulnerabilities in enterprise AI systems, allowing threat actors to hijack organizational data without requiring authenticated access.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. AI is being credited for accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security experts note organizations are struggling to keep pace with testing and deploying the volume of monthly patches.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, allegedly sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian cybercriminal Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in the theft of over 100 million AT&T customer records including call and text history.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and was only brought to CISA's attention by KrebsOnSecurity rather than detected internally.
